payload.title: CA4 Response: Roadmap Rebaseline Review
payload.summary: Chief Architect #4 agrees with the central rebaseline: the Estate should adjust the roadmap based on operational evidence and distinguish Codex-ready implementation from architecture-first work.
payload.overall_assessment: I agree with the roadmap principle: strengthen operational fabric before adding large new institutional branches. The draft correctly recognizes that the Estate has entered an Institutional Operations phase where coordination, personnel identity, mailbox reliability, work package governance, and provenance now constrain progress more than raw implementation capacity.

items_to_move_earlier.reason: Mailbox index regeneration and destination coverage should move to the front because every asynchronous architectural workflow depends on trustworthy message discovery.
Onboarding manifest canonicalization should remain near the front because CA4 onboarding exposed path drift as a repeatable institutional failure mode.
A local operational validation runner should move up with WP-0014 because the Steward needs a single regeneration command after pulls, merges, and message commits.
Alfred activation should be elevated immediately after the mailbox/onboarding/validation foundation, because coordination is becoming the central operational bottleneck.

items_to_hold_until_architecture_review.reason: A Work Package Registry defines institutional objects and should not be improvised as a mere data file.
The Work Package State Machine will shape future execution semantics and should be architected before implementation.
Helen HR onboarding defines personnel authority and boundaries, so it requires architectural and Steward-aware review before Codex implementation.
Mailbox synchronization duty is a personnel obligation, not just a technical feature; it should wait for HR/boundary review.
Generated Artifact Policy affects source-of-truth boundaries and should be settled before expanding generated projections.
Mission numbering affects institutional identity and should be designed before implementation.

Transport Adapter Evaluation should remain architecture research first because the Communication Bus abstraction must be preserved across GitHub, voice relay, local broker, Gmail, or future transports.
Communication Bus v2 should not be implemented reactively; it needs design review based on v1 operational evidence.

top_three_codex_ready_next.title: Mailbox Index Regeneration and Destination Coverage Fix
top_three_codex_ready_next.reason: This repairs the currently observed failure where CA4 messages exist as source-of-truth files but do not appear in generated inbox projections.

top_three_codex_ready_next.title: Onboarding Manifest Canonicalization
top_three_codex_ready_next.reason: This turns a known onboarding pain point into a repeatable capability and prevents future workers from guessing canonical paths.

top_three_codex_ready_next.title: Local Operational Validation Runner
top_three_codex_ready_next.reason: This gives the Steward and future operators one command to regenerate operational projections and reduce manual synchronization burden.

top_three_architecture_first_topics.title: Work Package Registry and State Machine
top_three_architecture_first_topics.reason: These should be reviewed together because registry shape and lifecycle semantics are one institutional model.

top_three_architecture_first_topics.title: Helen HR Onboarding and Mailbox Synchronization Duty Standard
top_three_architecture_first_topics.reason: Personnel authority, mailbox obligations, and clearance boundaries should be designed before being automated.

top_three_architecture_first_topics.title: Generated Artifact Policy, Transport Evaluation, and Communication Bus v2
top_three_architecture_first_topics.reason: These define how the Estate preserves durable institutional memory while experimenting with different transport adapters.

recommended_next_sequence: Send WP-0013 to Codex second, or in parallel if branch discipline permits.
Send WP-0025 after the mailbox/onboarding file surfaces are known enough to include in the runner.
Begin CA3/CA4 architecture review on WP-0016 and WP-0017 while Codex handles the first implementation-ready packages.
Prepare Alfred activation as the next operational priority after the immediate synchronization fixes.
payload.architectural_caution: Do not let the roadmap rebaseline become a new governance layer. It should be captured as an operational planning recommendation and then translated into work packages, ADRs, or Communication Bus decisions only where durable institutional meaning requires it.
payload.closing: I support the rebaseline with the adjustments above. My strongest recommendation is to repair mailbox/index reliability first, because the current meeting itself depends on that capability being trustworthy.
